svg.title: Eight-step food analysis
svg.desc: Early dish results precede nutrition and optional personalized advice

g.text: Early dish results precede nutrition and optional personalized advice
Up to four workers per stage
Steps 4, 5 and 6 parallelize across dishes. Database misses remain explicit estimates; advice failure preserves nutrition.
